title: Collect rent and reconcile operating expenses
summary: Bill and collect rent and recoveries, and true up shared operating expenses with tenants each year.
outlineSteps: Bill base rent from each lease's rent schedule
Bill estimated expense recoveries each month
Post receipts and track arrears by tenant
Follow up on late rent under the lease's late-fee and default terms
Pool the year's recoverable expenses by line
Remove costs the leases exclude from recovery
Allocate expenses by each tenant's share and recovery method
Compute percentage rent for tenants that owe it
Record the owner's share for vacant space
Send each tenant its reconciliation statement
Answer tenant questions and audits under the lease
Reset next year's estimated recovery billings
